title: Introduce stepwise RAG authoring kiosk and Go agent examples with telemetry probes
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds a compact stepwise authoring "kiosk" quickstart for building RAG workflows and a minimal Go-based example agent that demonstrates tool-calling, structured output, and telemetry probes. Motivation: provide a low-friction, reproducible onboarding path for engineers who want to prototype multi-step retrieval workflows locally and validate them with lightweight step assertions. The kiosk is intentionally opinionated: it exposes a guided step sequencer, live index preview, and a watch-mode that mirrors edits to a local authoring file. The Go sample agent demonstrates secure tool invocation patterns, streaming handling, and a small telemetry shim that emits step-level events compatible with Redwood Console. Checklist: - [x] Add stepwise authoring UI quickstart with README, run instructions, and configuration templates - [x] Add Go sample agent with tool stubs and example tests - [x] Add telemetry probe YAML schema and example probe rules - [x] Integrate smoke CI job for quickstart validation - [x] Provide migration notes and compatibility guidance (no breaking API changes) How to run locally: 1) git clone the repo and cd quickstarts/rag-kiosk 2) docker-compose up --build to start the kiosk (or run the dev script for watch mode) 3) in another shell, cd golang/sample-agent && go run ./cmd/agent to start the example agent 4) follow the README-guided scenario to step through a retrieval + tool call sequence Notes on telemetry: the probes/ directory contains small example YAML rules that assert presence/ordering of events (step.enter, step.exit, tool.call). These are intentionally pluggable; customers can adapt them to Redwood Console ingestion. CI and test strategy: added a lightweight smoke job runs the kiosk in headless mode and exercises the Go agent over localhost; tests are intentionally small to keep CI latency low. Rollout and compatibility: this is an additive quickstart; it does not modify existing APIs or infra. Recommended canary: ship as preview docs to docs.redwood.ai and monitor telemetry event rates for the sample scenario. See release_notes for user-facing guidance.

release_notes: Add a new RAG stepwise authoring quickstart (rag-kiosk) with a minimal Go agent demonstrating tool-calling and telemetry probes. This is an additive developer quickstart intended for prototyping and local debugging. Includes smoke CI and schema validation for telemetry.
notes_for_engineers: Design rationale: keep the kiosk small and opinionated so teams can iterate quickly. The Go agent intentionally avoids heavy dependencies and demonstrates a recommended pattern for tool auth and streaming. Telemetry probes are example-driven and can be extended by customers.
